faqs.q: What services do you offer as a contractor?
faqs.a: We provide a wide range of contracting services, including construction, renovation, and project management, tailored to meet client needs.

faqs.q: How do you ensure project deadlines are met?
faqs.a: We plan every project with clear milestones, assign dedicated managers and track progress weekly with the client.

faqs.q: What qualifications do your contractors have?
faqs.a: All contractors are licensed, insured and verified by our team before they can bid on tenders.

faqs.q: How do you handle project cost estimation?
faqs.a: We provide detailed itemised estimates up front and flag any changes before work begins.

faqs.q: What is your process for handling client feedback?
faqs.a: Feedback is collected at each milestone and addressed within two business days.
